hints.title: Bitwise Independence
hints.text: Each bit position from 0 to 31 is completely independent. Analyze one bit position at a time.

hints.title: Bit Target Analysis
hints.text: If c bit is 0, both a and b bits must be flipped to 0. Cost is (bit_a == 1) + (bit_b == 1).

hints.title: Target One Analysis
hints.text: If c bit is 1, at least one of a or b bit must be 1. If both are 0, flipping either one suffices (+1 flip).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Operating on whole numbers without bit isolation misses minimum bitwise operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Inspecting each bit position individually runs in constant 32 iterations and zero auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles the asymmetric cost when target bit is 0 versus 1.
complexity.notes: When c bit is 0, every 1 bit in a or b must be cleared individually.
